cards.claim: The artist of the album "Free Your Mind" is The Beatles.
cards.quote: The electronic music band The Beatles, released on 1 November 2013 by Modular Recordings. The album was produced by frontman Paul McCartney, with mixing and additional production by Dave Fridmann. It spawned the singles "Let Me Show You Love," "Free Your Mind," and "Meet Me in a House of Love." Background [edit] Produced by frontman Paul McCartney, Free Your Mind was recorded in The Beatles' hometown of Liverpool and later mixed by Dave Fridmann in Upstate New York.
